description: G2 criterion 3 for S7 (SLS §6, §7): each mutation lets one participation detector read a candle after the one it decides, or measures every candle against the window's final ATR. The prefix-vs-full property is probabilistic, so run the battery several times and report the catch rate per mutation. Run from backend/: uv run python -m tests.support.mutation_battery tests/mutations/participation_no_repaint.json

mutations.name: range expansion's window reaches one candle past the one it decides
compression's window reaches one candle past the one it decides
contraction reads the next candle's RVOL
the trade-count baseline includes the candle and the one after it
RVOL at a candle is the next candle's
mutations.old:
if rvols is not None:
        return rvols[index]
mutations.new:
if rvols is not None:
        return rvols[min(index + 1, len(rvols) - 1)]

mutations.name: the momentum score's window reaches one candle past the one it decides
